title: No Game, No Life
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Sora and his younger stepsister Shiro, shut-in gamers known online as the undefeated Blank, beat Tet, the god of games, at chess and are summoned to Disboard, a world where war and killing are forbidden and everything is settled by magically enforced games. They win the crown of the declining human kingdom Elkia and set out to defeat the other ruling species. The Seven Seas manga adapts the start of the light novels and ran two volumes.
life_message: Wit, strategy and the bond between siblings can beat stronger opponents when force is off the table.
